question: Should this PR be salvaged as a narrow no-visible-reasoning prompt guard, or should it stay behind the canonical replay-safe commitment context work?
rationale: The submitted branch mixes a useful prompt hardening with a context carrier that current replay deliberately filters, so automation cannot choose whether maintainers want a narrowed patch or a rebuilt context design.

options.title: Narrow This PR
options.body: Keep only the commitment prompt no-reasoning guard and focused regression coverage, leaving reply-context behavior to the canonical commitment work.

options.title: Rebuild As Context Fix
options.body: Replace the delivery-mirror transcript approach with a replay-safe pending-question or system-event mechanism and refresh Telegram proof on the repaired head.

options.title: Close And Replace
options.body: Close this stale branch and ask for a fresh narrow PR if maintainers do not want to carry the mixed proof and conflict history.

recommendation.title: Narrow This PR
recommendation.body: Keep only the commitment prompt no-reasoning guard and focused regression coverage, leaving reply-context behavior to the canonical commitment work.

likelyOwner.reason: The key unresolved choice is whether transcript mirrors may carry user-visible context, and the related mirror behavior traces to steipete's landed transcript/outbound mirror work.
